subject: Pilot pricing — SKU bundle vs. time-boxed credits (Brightline Labs)
messages:
From: Sasha Khan <sasha@brightline.ai>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question on POC structure and pricing

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency profile looks promising for our ingestion pipeline. Before we lock dates for the POC, the procurement team asked for two parallel options so they can compare between legal/accounting: 1) a 6-week time-boxed pilot (closed environment) with a fixed price and support hours, and 2) a 90k-token "credit" bucket model we can burn through at our pace over 8 weeks.

Concretely: can you share the economics + any recommended guardrails for each approach (SLOs, allowed concurrency, KV cache expectations)? Also curious whether Redwood will consider a one-off intro discount for a first enterprise pilot — we have an internal budget cap for Q4.

Attached is a short product requirements note. Can you and your team propose options by EOD Thursday?

Appreciate it,
Sasha
Head of ML Engineering
Brightline Labs

---
Attachment: Brightline_requirements.pdf (pdf)"

From: camila.reyes@redwood.com
To: Sasha Khan <sasha@brightline.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on POC structure and pricing

Hi Sasha — great to hear from you.

We can do both structures; I put together two clear options and a recommendation based on your stated goals (validate latency, measure cost at 10k QPS simulated ingest). See the attached pricing grid and mutual action plan. High level:

- Option A — Time-boxed 6-week pilot (recommended for tight evaluation windows):
  - Fixed price: $22,500 (includes up to 40 support hours, priority queueing during business hours)
  - Throughput SLO: 95th percentile < 220ms for 512-token responses on the dedicated pilot pool (per our demo profile)
  - Optional extension: $3,500/week

- Option B — Token credit bucket (flexible consumption):
  - 90k-token bucket: $14,000 + $1,200 reserve for burst (effectively $15,200)
  - No guaranteed throughput beyond shared evaluation pool; recommend reserved throughput for peak tests (add-on)
  - Validity: 8 weeks from activation

Intro discount: we can offer a one-time 12% pilot discount on either option if you sign the MPA by Sep 24. Exclusions: production models and longer-term reserved capacity not included.

I copied Ben (discount approvals) and Marissa (AM / contract lead) to coordinate next steps. We'll flag the discount in the MPA and attach the pricing grid.

Next actions: if you prefer Option A, propose start/end dates and any required data access patterns so I can lock an isolated pilot pool. If Option B, tell us expected token burn profile so we can advise on burst/reserved add-ons.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
---
Attachments: Brightline_POC_pricing_grid_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), Brightline_Mutual_Action_Plan.docx (docx)

From: Sasha Khan <sasha@brightline.ai>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@brightline.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on POC structure and pricing

Thanks Camila — this is helpful. A couple of clarifying points from procurement and engineering:

1) Procurement wants the price in a fixed AR invoice line (they dislike credits). If we go with Option A, can the $22,500 be split into two invoices (50% on kickoff / 50% on delivery) for their internal cashflow?

2) Engineering would like to run a 3-day stress run at the end of week 4 that will generate heavy burst traffic (approx 250k tokens/day). If that’s allowed under the time-boxed scope, will you confirm any additional overage rates?

3) We might need the pilot window extended by 1 week depending on internal availability — is that the $3,500/week add-on only, or can you trade an increased credit bucket for an extra week at lower incremental cost?

We are excited to move forward but need these details before legal signs MPA.

Best,
Sasha

---
Quoted: "Option A — Time-boxed 6-week pilot (recommended for tight evaluation windows): Fixed price: $22,500""

From: camila.reyes@redwood.com
To: Sasha Khan <sasha@brightline.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on POC structure and pricing

Hi Sasha — answers inline and a couple of commercial flexes.

1) Invoicing: we can split the invoice 50/50 (kickoff/delivery) for the time-boxed pilot. We'll reflect payment milestones in the MPA.

2) Stress run: covered. The time-boxed pilot price includes one high-intensity burst up to 300k tokens/day if scheduled in advance and run during the agreed window. Any additional ad-hoc bursts outside the scheduled test are billed at our overage rate of $0.00009/token.

3) Extension vs. credit trade: two paths — we can do the $3,500/week extension, or convert remaining run-time value into a 40k-token supplemental bucket for $2,600 (effectively cheaper if you expect token-limited usage). If you need both time and tokens, we can combine at prorated rates.

Commercial flex: because Brightline is an early enterprise customer we're willing to increase the intro discount to 15% if you commit to a follow-on dedicated eval (term to be captured in the MPA). Marissa will scope the legal language for the MPA and Ben will confirm final discount approval.

Let me know which path you prefer and an approximate start date. If you want, we can run a short (20-minute) call to walk procurement through the invoicing & SOW.

Thanks,
Camila

---

- Operational: Confirm that the scheduled stress run requires a 72-hour advance notice so we can schedule capacity. Lock-pools will need a start/end date in the MPA.

Camila — please finalize the pricing grid with the 15% discount applied, add the 72-hour notice for bursts, and produce a redline-ready MPA for Brightline Legal. Ben — can you add a single line in the MPA about a one-time extension conversion (time -> token bucket) and the $2,600 amount?
